system.description:
Essence multiplies the force of the Lawgiver's blow. This Charm creates duplicates of the Exalt's Archery-based attack, usually meaning that one arrow or firewand charge becomes several in flight.

The Solar spends three motes per duplicate attack and can create up to (her permanent Essence score) duplicate attacks. Treat the original attack and all duplicates as a single attack when making attack and defense rolls, but if they hit, calculate the damage for each attack separately. If Rain of Feathered Death is used with ammunition costing more than one dot of Resources per shot or placed in a Combo with Charms that affect the arrow's damage, the cost for this Charm increases to eight motes per duplicate. All duplicates fade after the attack.
